source_title: 10.000 Moving Cities, Augmented Reality Multiplayer Game
desc_src: 10.000 Moving Cities – Same but Different, AR (Augmented Reality) Mobile App, AR Multiplayer Game With the Augmented Reality App 10.000 Moving Cities – Same but Different one moves between the imaginary buildings via smartphone and tablet and participates in the digital communication streams and social movements of our time by means of inserted Social Media Posts. The buildings can be destroyed and rebuilt by the users. But beware! Everyone sees what the other is doing from different perspectives. The more buildings disappear, the more creatures appear.
